svg.title: Index Translator browser components, output
svg.desc: The page shows the output as Markdown when the source looks like Markdown, and builds the DOM from the parser's blocks with no innerHTML. The link check marks the output's links against the source and the paragraph check compares the blocks. Clicking a link opens the confirmation dialog, and clicking a paragraph syncs the two sides through the same paragraph alignment. output: public/app.ts → public/markdown-dom.ts → public/links.ts → public/paragraphs.ts.
